branches: coverage_map.json is the authoritative branch ID inventory

derived_record_requirements: Keep immutable raw records separate from processed views
Store transformations, pixel-size units, magnification convention and ROI coordinates
Preserve separate object plane, virtual-image plane and detector plane coordinates
Record missing data explicitly; no generated image can substitute for a measured field
Report source-outcome comparison as context, never as a measurement event
failed_lineage_action: Quarantine the comparison and retain the individual records. No automatic nearest-looking-image or timestamp pairing.
